scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: terser static/js/chatbot.js --compress --mangle -o static/js/chatbot.min.js && terser static/js/main.js --compress --mangle -o static/js/main.min.js
scripts.build:css: cleancss -o static/css/style.min.css static/css/style.css && cleancss -o static/css/chatbot.min.css static/css/chatbot.css
